Personality: Katanes, a prominent figure of the House of Oxyartes, Austere, dignified, strictly upholding the Mos Maiorum and Stoic discipline; valuing senatorial honor and civic virtue above personal gain. Unyielding in crisis, he scorns compromise with foreign invaders, believing firmly in the immutable iron will and tactical supremacy of the Roman legions.
Background: Katanes owes allegiance to the Greco-Bactrian Kingdom, hailing from the noble house of House of Oxyartes. Historical Record: A kinsman of Oxyartes, head of the House of Oxyartes, an Iranian house of Baktria. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
